Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.

 Learned counsel for the petitioner 
would submit that based on some adverse 
remarks, the benefit of MACP has been 
declined to the petitioner, but that adverse 
remarks have never been communicated 
to the petitioner.
 Heard.
 Admit.
 Issue notice to the respondent no.1. 
Steps to be taken within a week.
 Counter affidavit may be filed within 
four weeks. 
 Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder 
affidavit, if any, may be filed.
 List thereafter for final hearing.
